conclusion: No sheet in the set prints a head track / track header / additional track at the head of door or window openings in metal stud walls, nor a rule for openings wider than 4'-0", nor a header/track bearing length past the jamb. Closest printed items: A5.1/7 '600S162-33 COLD FORM METAL BOX HEADER' (header only, no track called out), A5.1/8 'DOUBLE STUDS AT JAMBS', S1.1 7.D strapping/blocking 'ADJACENT TO OPENINGS' and 7.F end-anchor 'ADJACENT TO ALL WALL OPENINGS', A1.1 note 2.E (refers back to the head/jamb/sill details). The only 4'-0"/8'-0" opening-width values are MAXIMUM widths in the S4.1 MASONRY lintel schedule (CMU, not studs). S5.1-S5.3 have no typical opening detail. An additional head track would be an assumption / RFI, not a printed requirement.
